[project]
name = "sample-app"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = ["flask>=3.0", "pydantic>=2", "flask-cors"]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

from app.models import UserStore

store = UserStore()


def list_users() -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [u.__dict__ for u in store.all()]
